tasks.sql: WITH request_stats AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_request WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM系统' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM')  GROUP BY page_name, request_url_simple HAVING visit_count > 30), total_visits AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visit_count FROM request_stats), slow_requests AS (SELECT page_name, request_url_simple, visit_count, avg_duration FROM request_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT page_name as "业务页面名称", request_url_simple as "请求URL（多种渠道端口，取其一）", visit_count as "访问次数", round(avg_duration,0) AS  "响应时长(ms)"  FROM slow_requests ORDER BY round(avg_duration,0) DESC;
tasks.dataset: 页面请求(按钮)响应时长大于3s

tasks.sql: WITH page_stats AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_page WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM系统' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY  AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM') GROUP BY page_name, page_url_simple_hash HAVING visit_count > 30), total_visits AS (SELECT SUM(visit_count) AS total_visit_count FROM page_stats), slow_pages AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, visit_count, avg_duration FROM page_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "慢加载页面个数", SUM(visit_count) AS "慢访问次数", round((SUM(visit_count) / (SELECT total_visit_count FROM total_visits)) * 100, 2) AS "慢访问占比（%）" FROM slow_pages;
tasks.dataset: 大于3s的页面访问量占比

tasks.sql: WITH page_stats AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, AVG(duration) AS avg_duration FROM appuser.ods_browser_page WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM系统' AND accept_time > NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND page_name NOT IN ('', '403错误', '错误提示', 'WPS WebOffice', '客户关系管理系统CRM')  GROUP BY page_name, page_url_simple_hash HAVING visit_count > 30), slow_pages AS (SELECT page_name, page_url_simple_hash, visit_count, avg_duration FROM page_stats WHERE avg_duration > 3000) SELECT page_name as "页面名称", page_url_simple_hash as "页面URL", visit_count as "访问量", ROUND(avg_duration, 0) AS "平均加载时长" FROM slow_pages;

SELECT  CASE local_application_id WHEN '01a01e24-4299-7cfc-9258-7cd3a0e50991' THEN '接口APP' WHEN '019e49dd-1a6c-7e48-9291-fc5d660f0a43' THEN '新一代CRM' WHEN '01a01e79-9fd6-742d-8207-c861af088f08' THEN 'CRM-WEB' ELSE local_application_id END AS "应用",count(1) as "访问量",cast(round(avg(duration),0) as varchar) as "平均响应耗时" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service where local_application_id in ('01a01e24-4299-7cfc-9258-7cd3a0e50991','019e49dd-1a6c-7e48-9291-fc5d660f0a43','01a01e79-9fd6-742d-8207-c861af088f08') and trace_kind ='APM'  and accept_time>= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 7 day) group by local_application_id order by "应用"
tasks.dataset: 后端应用平均响应时长

tasks.sql: SELECT application_name as "应用",cast(round(sum(value)/1000,0)as varchar)  as "Full GC时长" from appuser.ods_common_metric where application_name in ('CRM-web','新一代CRM','接口APP') and metric ='jvm.gc.full-gc.time' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 7 day)  GROUP by application_name order by application_name

SELECT count(1) as "访问量",round(avg(duration),0)  as "平均响应耗时(ms)" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service  where local_system_id ='019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff' and trace_kind ='APM' and service_type ='Accept URL' and url not like '%jsp' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 5 DAY)

tasks.sql: SELECT COUNT(1) AS "总访问量",COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) AS "大于1秒的访问量", ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1), 2 ) AS "占比(%)"  FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service  WHERE local_system_id = '019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff'  AND trace_kind = 'APM' and service_type ='Accept URL' and url not like '%jsp'  AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 day);

tasks.sql: SELECT  count(1) as "访问量",round(avg(duration),0) as "平均响应耗时(ms)" from appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_sql  where local_system_id ='019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff' and trace_kind ='APM' and call_type ='SQL' and accept_time >= DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL 7 day)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "总访问量",COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) AS "大于1秒的访问量" ,ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN duration >= 1000 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1),4) AS "占比(%)" FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_sql WHERE local_system_id = '019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff' AND trace_kind = 'APM' AND call_type = 'SQL' AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 day);

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "总访问量", SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "失败量", round((1- SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(1)) * 100, 4) AS "成功率(%)"  FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service WHERE accept_time >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND trace_kind = 'APM' AND service_type = 'Accept URL' AND local_system_id = '019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff' AND service NOT LIKE '%/probe.jsp';

tasks.sql: SELECT service as "CRM服务接口", COUNT(1) AS "访问量", SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "失败量", round((1-SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(1)) * 100, 2) AS "成功率(%)"  FROM appuser.dwd_apm_trace_span_service WHERE accept_time >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND trace_kind = 'APM' AND service_type = 'Accept URL' AND local_system_id = '019e49dc-ab60-7bfa-b55a-a07f35b0e4ff' AND service NOT LIKE '%/probe.jsp' GROUP BY service HAVING count(1) > 1000 ORDER BY "成功率(%)";
tasks.dataset: 后端单个接口-失败次数、整体成功率

tasks.sql: WITH error_summary AS (SELECT error_type, message, page_url_simple_hash, COUNT(*) AS c FROM appuser.ods_browser_error WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM系统' AND accept_time > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND error_source_type = 'javascript' AND message NOT IN ('', 'Uncaught ReferenceError: android_apm is not defined', 'Script error.', 'Unhandled promise rejection: false') GROUP BY error_type, message, page_url_simple_hash HAVING c > 3000), total_records AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM appuser.ods_browser_error WHERE local_biz_system_name = 'CRM系统' AND accept_time > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND error_source_type = 'javascript' AND message NOT IN ('', 'Uncaught ReferenceError: android_apm is not defined', 'Script error.')) SELECT es.message as "报错名称", SUM(es.c) AS "报错次数", tr.total_count as "总报错量" FROM error_summary es, total_records tr GROUP BY es.message, tr.total_count ORDER BY "报错次数" DESC;
tasks.dataset: 前端页面 JS 报错

tasks.sql: SELECT CASE application_id WHEN '01a01e24-4299-7cfc-9258-7cd3a0e50991' THEN '接口APP' WHEN '019e49dd-1a6c-7e48-9291-fc5d660f0a43' THEN '新一代CRM' WHEN '01a01e79-9fd6-742d-8207-c861af088f08' THEN 'CRM-WEB' ELSE application_id END AS "应用", type as "异常名称", count(`type`) as "异常次数" FROM appuser.ods_apm_exception WHERE application_id IN ('01a01e24-4299-7cfc-9258-7cd3a0e50991','019e49dd-1a6c-7e48-9291-fc5d660f0a43','01a01e79-9fd6-742d-8207-c861af088f08') AND type NOT IN ('com.ailk.biz.exception.BizException','com.ailk.common.BaseException') AND accept_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY application_id, type HAVING count(1) > 50 ORDER BY count(`type`) DESC;
